backup.production_rule: Guest guide v8.0.0 backend (s135), additive only: five tables guide_threads, guide_sessions, guide_messages, guide_auth_attempts, guide_events (RLS on, no policies, no grants to anon or authenticated); four guest RPCs (guide_session_v1, guide_thread_v1, guide_send_v1, guide_track_v1; anon and authenticated, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty); five staff RPCs (staff_guide_threads_v1, staff_guide_thread_v1, staff_guide_reply_v1, staff_guide_resolve_v1, staff_guide_usage_v1; authenticated only, gated by current_staff_authorized('manage_guest_inbox'); a missing thread id raises P0002 before the 42501 access check); the token helper, the push trigger function and guide_sweep_v1 (service_role only) have no client grants; trigger guide_messages_push on guide_messages calls notify-staff-inbox through pg_net and the vault secret and never fails the insert. guide_session_v1 refuses a booking whose name is a placeholder (reason no_name, no thread), keys its per-address throttle on cf-connecting-ip or the rightmost x-forwarded-for entry, allows 10 failures per check-in date per 15 minutes and 20 sessions per thread per day (reason busy); guide_track_v1 caps events per device (600/hour) and globally (3000/minute, then drops silently) by arrival time and keeps only whitelisted short scalar meta values; staff_guide_usage_v1 answers only for the default property (single-property, other ids get an empty flagged object); service_role has explicit full access to the five tables and the two identity sequences are closed to anon and authenticated. No existing table, function or setting is touched; verify_booking is called, not replaced. Phase is backfill, not expand, only because the body of guide_sweep_v1 contains DELETE FROM (housekeeping of the new tables), which release-safety refuses in an expand migration; the migration itself deletes no existing row and writes no data.
backup.notes: Apply after s134 and cf_confirm_flow (20261205000000) are applied; re-timed from 20261205000000 to 20261206000000 in s136 because cf_confirm_flow holds 20261205000000 live. The migration carries no begin/commit of its own (the runner wraps it). Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). After the apply add select public.guide_sweep_v1() to the weekly sweep (or a pg_cron job guide-sweep-weekly) and confirm notify-staff-inbox accepts {kind guest_wrote, psid guide:<uuid>} from the database caller. The Staff app Guide inbox and the guide v8.0.0 frontend follow the SQL.

forward_verification.name: guide_tables_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 5 from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events')

forward_verification.name: guide_rls_on_all_five
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(c.relrowsecurity) and count(*) = 5 from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relname in ('guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events')

forward_verification.name: guide_anon_has_no_table_grants
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from information_schema.role_table_grants where grantee in ('anon','authenticated') and table_schema = 'public' and table_name like 'guide\_%')

forward_verification.name: guide_anon_may_not_call_staff_functions
forward_verification.query: select not bool_or(has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.staff_guide_threads_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_thread_v1(uuid)','public.staff_guide_reply_v1(uuid,text,text)','public.staff_guide_resolve_v1(uuid,boolean)','public.staff_guide_usage_v1(integer,uuid)','public.guide_token_thread_v1(text)','public.guide_sweep_v1()']::regprocedure[]) f

forward_verification.name: guide_definer_functions_pin_search_path
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) and count(*) >= 12 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and (p.proname like 'guide\_%' or p.proname like 'staff\_guide\_%')

forward_verification.name: guide_push_trigger_present
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger where tgname = 'guide_messages_push' and not tgisinternal)

forward_verification.name: guide_service_role_has_full_table_access
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.' || t, p)) from unnest(array['guide_threads','guide_sessions','guide_messages','guide_auth_attempts','guide_events']) t, unnest(array['select','insert','update','delete']) p

forward_verification.name: guide_identity_sequences_closed_to_clients
forward_verification.query: select not bool_or(has_sequence_privilege(r, 'public.' || q, p)) from unnest(array['anon','authenticated']) r, unnest(array['guide_auth_attempts_id_seq','guide_events_id_seq']) q, unnest(array['usage','select','update']) p

rollback.safe_until: Any time. The rollback drops the trigger, the twelve functions and the five tables of this release; guest messages and usage events are deleted with their tables (export public.guide_messages first with the read-only runner if they matter). Nothing else is touched.

steps.name: rollback_clients_first
steps.action: Revert the guide v8.0.0 frontend and the Cascade-Staff Guide inbox push first (they call the new functions); until then the guide degrades to the Airbnb / Messenger / call / e-mail options and analytics calls fail silently.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261206_guide_v8.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; select count(*) from pg_tables where tablename like guide_% must then read 0.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Additive: the live guide keeps working without the SQL (the Messages tab keeps its contact options, analytics calls fail silently and are dropped after 200 queued events). The v8.0.0 frontend and the Staff app Guide inbox need this SQL first.

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed 2026-11-25 on a restored copy of production backup cascade-supabase-20261124T145205Z (142 public tables, 237 ledger rows) on host alfred, log .rehearsal-logs/rehearsal-guide_v8-r2.log, exit 8 only because of the accepted_failing_tests baseline. Sequence in one container: ACL snapshot, apply 20261206000000, 12 forward checks (in SQL), rollback supabase/rollbacks/20261206_guide_v8.sql with checks (0 guide_* relations, tables, functions or trigger left; public table count and the md5 of every non-guide table, function, default and schema ACL identical to before), apply again, the 12 forward checks again, state fingerprint (function bodies and ACLs, columns, indexes, trigger) identical to the first apply. The runner then ran the 12 forward checks a third time: 12 passed, 0 failed. pgTAP guide_v8_messages_analytics 103 of 103; the seven baseline suites fail exactly the numbers in accepted_failing_tests and none else (compared by number). The rollback and re-apply steps ran as temporary untracked migrations that were deleted afterwards; nothing temporary is in git.

the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (verify_booking, current_staff_authorized or calendar_events missing, or public.guide_threads already exists)

the rehearsal has not run the migration (apply, rollback, apply again, forward checks after each) and the suite guide_v8_messages_analytics on this commit, or any test fails outside the accepted_failing_tests lists, or compatibility.verified is still false
